cw425.name: Wall push-up
cw425.description: A standing push-up with both hands against a stable wall. Bend and straighten your arms while keeping your trunk and hips aligned, using only a comfortable range.
cues: Face a stable wall from roughly an arm length away, standing on a non-slip floor.
Place your palms at chest height with your fingers pointing upwards.
Keep your trunk and hips in one line, with your feet staying on the floor.
Slowly bend your elbows close to your sides and bring your chest towards the wall within a comfortable range.
Press away smoothly to return to the starting position.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Letting your hands or feet slide.
Reaching forwards with only your head.
Pushing away with a sudden bounce.
cw425.tempo: About 2 seconds in each direction, without swinging or bouncing.
cw425.progression: First add smooth repetitions, then move your feet a little farther from the wall only while remaining stable.
cw425.regression: Stand closer to the wall and reduce both the range and the number of repetitions.

cw426.name: Bodyweight squat
cw426.description: An unloaded squat performed without hand support. Bend your hips and knees together, keep your whole feet planted and return to standing without forcing depth.
cues: Stand steadily with your feet slightly wider than your hips and your toes turned slightly outwards.
Reach your arms forwards without resting them on equipment.
Move your hips back and slowly bend your hips and knees, keeping your knees aligned with the direction of your feet.
Lower only as far as you can keep your whole feet down and your back position controlled.
Press your feet into the floor and straighten your hips and knees without jerking.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Allowing your trunk to drop without control.
cw426.tempo: About 2 seconds in each direction, without swinging or bouncing.
cw426.progression: Add repetitions or gradually use a larger controlled range without adding external weight.
cw426.regression: Use a shallower squat and fewer repetitions; do not force your thighs to reach parallel.

cw427.name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
cw427.description: An unloaded step backwards into a shallow lunge, followed by a controlled return to standing. The rear knee stays above the floor throughout; this is not a kneeling exercise.
cues: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, space behind you and no weights in your hands.
Step one foot back onto its forefoot, keeping some sideways distance between your feet.
Slowly bend both legs while guiding the front knee in the direction of its toes.
Keep the rear knee above the floor throughout the movement; do not kneel down.
Press the whole front foot into the floor and return to standing without bouncing.
Complete a short set on one side, then change legs.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Placing both feet on one narrow line.
Dropping the rear knee onto the floor.
Letting the front knee collapse inwards.
Swinging your trunk to return to standing.
cw427.tempo: About 2 seconds in each direction, without swinging or bouncing.
cw427.progression: Add controlled repetitions on each side or slightly increase the comfortable range.
cw427.regression: Take a shorter step and bend less deeply. If you cannot balance without hand support, choose a different exercise.

cw428.name: March in place
cw428.description: A gentle stationary march with alternating low foot lifts and relaxed arm movements. Time covers the whole alternating sequence, not a separate interval for each leg.
cues: Stand on a level, non-slip surface with clear space around you.
Alternate low foot lifts and set each foot down quietly beneath your hip.
Keep your trunk upright, look ahead and breathe calmly.
Let your slightly bent arms move freely in rhythm with your steps.
Stay in the same place, without bouncing or forcing your knees high.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Marching so fast that comfortable conversation becomes difficult.
cw428.tempo: A calm, even rhythm without bouncing.
cw428.progression: Gradually lengthen a short marching interval at a pace that still allows comfortable conversation.
cw428.regression: Lift your feet less, slow down and use a shorter interval with a rest break.

cw429.name: Seated march
cw429.description: Alternate small bent-knee lifts while sitting upright on a stable chair and lightly holding its sides. Measure the total time spent alternating, rather than time per leg.
cues: Choose a stable chair without wheels on a non-slip surface, with your feet resting flat on the floor.
Sit upright away from the backrest and lightly hold the sides of the seat for stability.
Lift one foot a little with the knee bent, without leaning your trunk backwards.
Set the foot down gently and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating at a calm rhythm without tugging or rocking the chair.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
cw429.tempo: A calm, even rhythm without bouncing.
cw429.progression: Lengthen the time spent alternating calmly without increasing your pace.
cw429.regression: Lift each foot only slightly, shorten the interval and rest between attempts.

cw430.name: Seated knee extension
cw430.description: An unloaded seated knee extension with the thigh supported by the chair. Straighten and bend one knee slowly within a comfortable range, without a band or ankle weight.
cues: Choose a stable chair without wheels on a non-slip surface, with your feet resting flat on the floor.
Sit upright with your hands resting loosely on your thighs, not supporting your body weight.
Keep your thigh on the seat and slowly straighten one knee, lifting the foot in front of you and gently drawing your toes towards your shin.
Stop at a comfortable range without abruptly locking the knee.
Slowly bend the knee and return your foot to the floor.
After a short set, change legs; do not use a resistance band or ankle weight.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Lifting your thigh off the seat.
cw430.tempo: About 2 seconds in each direction, without swinging or bouncing.
cw430.progression: Add controlled repetitions or a brief calm pause near extension, without adding external resistance.
cw430.regression: Use a smaller comfortable range and fewer repetitions on each side.

cw431.name: Bodyweight fire hydrant
cw431.description: A small sideways lift of a bent leg from a hands-and-knees position, without a band. Move at the hip while keeping the pelvis still rather than lifting the knee as high as possible.
cues: Place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips on a level, comfortable surface, without a resistance band.
Keep your back steady, lightly engage your abdomen and look down.
Keep the knee bent at about a right angle and lift one leg sideways with a small movement at the hip.
Do not rotate your pelvis or trunk and do not lift the knee beyond about 45 degrees; a smaller range is enough.
Slowly return the knee beneath your hip and change sides after a short set.
A mat may make the position more comfortable, but it is not required.
Breathe freely.
End the set before you lose control of the movement.
Stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.
errors: Straightening the knee instead of moving the hip sideways.
cw431.tempo: About 2 seconds in each direction, without swinging or bouncing.
cw431.progression: Add smooth repetitions or a short pause while keeping the pelvis still.
cw431.regression: Reduce the range and the number of repetitions. If kneeling or supporting yourself on your hands is uncomfortable, choose a different exercise.
